topic: Debugging API rate limits and retries
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on debugging repeated 'Too Many Requests' (429 RateLimitError) when calling the OpenAI API, specifically related to embedding generation. It was noted that the observed rate limiting and retrying behavior is handled automatically by the LlamaIndex framework, not explicitly added in the current code. The discussion concluded with a plan to update the mops-ai system.
